'''Nalan Retheur''' was an [[Actor/Legends|actor]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Kalio Entertainment]] recorded Retheur's brainwave patterns and attempted to recreate Retheur's movements and re-create the actor for a holoseries, but Retheur's estate objected.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
